# D526 — MFEM 4.10 nodal-point goldens for HDivSpace::dof_nodal_coords.
# Every number is a physical point quantised to 1e-6 (same key3 rule as
# the fem-rs tests: llround(x*1e6)).  Sources: probe d526_probe.cpp +
# wedge_ref.cpp (WSL mfem410_ser), dumps archived under tmp/d526/.
# Nodal-point convention: the FE::Nodes IntegrationRule slot of MFEM
# VectorFiniteElement, transformed by ElementTransformation.  Hex and
# pyramid cases are in-code meshes; the prism stack is the in-code twin
# of data/d394_prism_stack.mesh (the file itself parses as a curved-mesh
# header in MFEM and is not used on the MFEM side).
#
